NUTRITION
  STRATEGY "Anti-Inflammatory Foundation":
    - emphasize: vegetables (color variety), fruits (berries, citrus), legumes, nuts, seeds, whole grains (oats, quinoa, brown rice), herbs/spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic), tea/coffee in moderation
    - prioritize fats: extra-virgin olive oil, avocado, omega-3 rich fish (salmon, sardine, mackerel) 2..3 servings/week; plant sources (walnut, chia, flax)
    - protein: lean poultry, fish, tofu/tempeh, eggs, greek yogurt; target 1.6 g/kg/day protein across 3..4 meals
    - reduce: ultra-processed foods, refined sugars, excessive alcohol, trans fats; limit red/processed meats to 0..2 servings/week
    - fiber: aim 30..40 g/day with legumes and intact whole grains
    - hydration: 30..35 ml/kg/day water; include walking post-meal 10..15 minutes
  MEAL_TIMING "Peri-Workout":
    - pre_workout: 1..2 hours pre, 20..40 g protein + 30..60 g low-fiber carbs
    - post_workout: within 2 hours, 30..40 g protein + produce; add 1..2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil at meals
  MICRO_NUTRIENTS "Key Focus":
    - omega_3: EPA+DHA 1..2 g/day via fish or supplements; consult physician if on anticoagulants
    - vitamin_D: test and supplement per clinician; common 1000..2000 IU/day when deficient
    - magnesium: 200..400 mg/day (glycinate/citrate) if intake low
    - polyphenols: berries, olive oil, dark leafy greens daily
  WEEKLY_HABITS "Behavior Anchors":
    - plan_shop_prep: plan 3..4 dinners; batch-cook legumes/whole grains
    - plate_building: half vegetables, quarter protein, quarter whole grains or starchy veg
    - alcohol_sleep: cap alcohol at 0..2 drinks/week; target 7..9 hours sleep
    - check_in: weigh or waist measure once/week; note pain/soreness and energy

RECOVERY
  SLEEP_GOALS:
    - duration_target: 7..9 hours/night
    - consistency: fixed bedtime and wake time within 30 minutes daily
    - pre_sleep_light: dim lights and screens 60 minutes before bed; use night mode if needed
    - environment: cool 17..19 C, dark, quiet; consider eye mask and earplugs
    - caffeine: cut off 8 hours before bedtime
    - alcohol: avoid or keep to 0..1 drink on non-training days
  DAILY_HABITS:
    - morning_light: get 5..10 minutes outdoor light within 1 hour of waking
    - movement_breaks: 3x5 minutes walking spread through the workday
    - post_training_walk: 10 minutes walking after sessions
    - hydration_rhythm: start day with 300..500 ml water; steady intake until 2 hours before bed
    - breath_breaks: 2x2 minutes diaphragmatic_breathing mid-day
  WEEKLY_PRACTICES:
    - low_intensity_aerobic: optional walking 20..30 minutes on rest days if not fatigued
    - mobility_block: 1x20 minutes total-body stretches on light day
    - hot_cold: warm shower 10 minutes pre-bed if it aids sleep

  STRATEGY "Anti-Inflammatory Foundation":
    - emphasize: vegetables (color variety), fruits (berries, citrus), legumes, nuts, seeds, whole grains (oats, quinoa, brown rice), herbs/spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic), tea/coffee in moderation
    - prioritize fats: extra-virgin olive oil, avocado, omega-3 rich fish (salmon, sardine, mackerel) 2..3 servings/week; plant sources (walnut, chia, flax)
    - protein: lean poultry, fish, tofu/tempeh, eggs, greek yogurt; target 1.6 g/kg/day protein across 3..4 meals
    - reduce: ultra-processed foods, refined sugars, excessive alcohol, trans fats; limit red/processed meats to 0..2 servings/week
    - fiber: aim 30..40 g/day with legumes and intact whole grains
    - hydration: 30..35 ml/kg/day water; include walking post-meal 10..15 minutes
  MEAL_TIMING "Peri-Workout":
    - pre_workout: 1..2 hours pre, 20..40 g protein + 30..60 g low-fiber carbs
    - post_workout: within 2 hours, 30..40 g protein + produce; add 1..2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil at meals
  MICRO_NUTRIENTS "Key Focus":
    - omega_3: EPA+DHA 1..2 g/day via fish or supplements; consult physician if on anticoagulants
    - vitamin_D: test and supplement per clinician; common 1000..2000 IU/day when deficient
    - magnesium: 200..400 mg/day (glycinate/citrate) if intake low
    - polyphenols: berries, olive oil, dark leafy greens daily
  WEEKLY_HABITS "Behavior Anchors":
    - plan_shop_prep: plan 3..4 dinners; batch-cook legumes/whole grains
    - plate_building: half vegetables, quarter protein, quarter whole grains or starchy veg
    - alcohol_sleep: cap alcohol at 0..2 drinks/week; target 7..9 hours sleep
    - check_in: weigh or waist measure once/week; note pain/soreness and energy

RECOVERY
  SLEEP_GOALS:
    - duration_target: 7..9 hours/night
    - consistency: fixed bedtime and wake time within 30 minutes daily
    - pre_sleep_light: dim lights and screens 60 minutes before bed; use night mode if needed
    - environment: cool 17..19 C, dark, quiet; consider eye mask and earplugs
    - caffeine: cut off 8 hours before bedtime
    - alcohol: avoid or keep to 0..1 drink on non-training days
  DAILY_HABITS:
    - morning_light: get 5..10 minutes outdoor light within 1 hour of waking
    - movement_breaks: 3x5 minutes walking spread through the workday
    - post_training_walk: 10 minutes walking after sessions
    - hydration_rhythm: start day with 300..500 ml water; steady intake until 2 hours before bed
    - breath_breaks: 2x2 minutes diaphragmatic_breathing mid-day
  WEEKLY_PRACTICES:
    - low_intensity_aerobic: optional walking 20..30 minutes on rest days if not fatigued
    - mobility_block: 1x20 minutes total-body stretches on light day
    - hot_cold: warm shower 10 minutes pre-bed if it aids sleep
    - reflect_log: note sleep duration, quality, soreness, back symptoms 3x/week
  TEST_WEEK_TWEAKS:
    - naps: 20..30 minutes early afternoon Monday and Wednesday if sleep debt present
    - screen_fast: 90-minute pre-bed screen break on test days
    - carb_with_dinner: include whole-grain or starchy veg with protein night before tests
    - alarm_buffer: set two alarms and allow extra 15 minutes morning mobility on test days
